descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands), we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you an experienced Software Engineer who enjoys writing high-quality code, solving complex technical challenges, and taking ownership of software from design to implementation and verification?
 You’ll develop software for advanced high-tech applications in domains such as semiconductors, medical technology, and smart industry. We’re looking for a hands-on engineer with strong C++ and Python development skills who can independently design and build reliable software components and contribute to the technical direction of a project.
 This is a hands-on software development role. Strong programming skills and experience building software are essential. 
 “What I enjoy is the ownership and opportunity you get to grow. Since our team works closely with our clients, you get the luxury of a familial company combined with high-quality high-tech projects. It is the best of both worlds” 
 Peter Barna | Software Architect @ TOPIC
 What will you do? 
 You’ll take ownership of software components throughout their development lifecycle: from understanding requirements and exploring design options to implementation, testing, and verification. Working closely with other software and hardware engineers, you’ll translate complex technical challenges into robust, maintainable software.
 Your responsibilities include:
Design, develop, test, and verify software components, modules, and subsystems using C++ and Python, and C where applicable.
Write, debug, and maintain production-quality code for embedded systems and other high-tech applications.
Translate technical requirements into well-designed software solutions, making independent technical decisions along the way.
Apply object-oriented design, software architecture principles, unit testing, and clean coding practices.
Analyse complex technical problems and evaluate alternative solutions.
Take responsibility for the quality, reliability, and maintainability of your software.
Review code, share technical knowledge, and support the development of less experienced engineers.
Collaborate with software, hardware, and other engineering specialists in an international, multidisciplinary team.
 What do we offer you? 
 This will make you smarter: 
Strategic projects in complex high-tech environments
Collaborate with other senior engineers and domain experts
Access to advanced training through our TOPIC Academy
Contribute to and lead tech events and knowledge sessions
 This will make you better: 
Permanent contract
An all-in employment package between €57.000 and €76.000 (including net expense allowance, mobility package, 13th-month salary and holiday allowance). Final salary is based on relevant work experience and level of expertise
26 vacation days (option to buy extra), pension scheme, relocation support
 This will keep you healthy: 
Good work-life balance, flexible hours, and hybrid working
Inspiring office with daily fresh fruit and a gym
Home office support for an inspiring work-from-home setup 
Regular fun, social, and sports events
 What do you bring? 
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field.
At least 5 years of hands-on software development experience , preferably in a high-tech or embedded environment.
Strong practical experience with both C++ and Python, including writing and maintaining software rather than working primarily with configuration, integration, or testing tools.
Experience designing and implementing software components in complex technical systems.
A solid understanding of object-oriented programming, software design principles, unit testing, and maintainable code.
The ability to work independently, make sound technical decisions, and take ownership of your work.
A proactive, analytical mindset and a genuine interest in solving challenging engineering problems.
The ability to communicate effectively in English. Dutch is an advantage.
 Our organization 
 Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Embedded Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs. 
 Diversity & Inclusion 
 At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We are building a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.
